# Vendored libraries

The site has no build step and no runtime CDN dependency. Each library below is a
single-file ES module generated once by [`scripts/vendor.sh`](../scripts/vendor.sh)
from a pinned npm version and committed. The entry files in
[`scripts/vendor_entries/`](../scripts/vendor_entries/) define which API is
exposed. Licence texts are in [`licenses/`](licenses/).

| File | Package | Version | Licence | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `satellite.js` | [satellite.js](https://github.com/shashwatak/satellite-js) | 7.1.0 | MIT | SGP4 propagation, ECI/ECF/geodetic transforms (WASM build excluded) |
| `proj4.js` | [proj4js](https://github.com/proj4js/proj4js) | 2.22.0 | MIT | ROI-centred LAEA projection, user CRS input |
| `polygon-clipping.js` | [polygon-clipping](https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping) | 0.15.7 | MIT | planar swath/ROI intersection |
| `geographiclib-geodesic.js` | [geographiclib-geodesic](https://github.com/geographiclib/geographiclib-js) | 2.2.0 | MIT | WGS84 geodesics (Karney) for swath construction |
| `fileformats.js` | [@tmcw/togeojson](https://github.com/placemark/togeojson), [shpjs](https://github.com/calvinmetcalf/shapefile-js) | 7.1.3, 6.2.0 | BSD-2-Clause, MIT | ROI files: KML/KMZ and zipped Shapefile (loaded on demand) |
| `maplibre/` | [MapLibre GL JS](https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js) | 6.17.0 | BSD-3-Clause | globe map (ESM build: `maplibre-gl.mjs` loads `maplibre-gl-worker.mjs` from the same folder) |
| `tz-lookup.js` | [tz-lookup](https://github.com/darkskyapp/tz-lookup-oss) | 6.1.25 | CC0-1.0 | IANA time zone of the ROI anchor |

Bundled transitive dependencies (inside the files above):

| Package | Version | Licence | Inside |
|---|---|---|---|
| splaytree | 3.2.3 | MIT (declared in package.json and inline `@license` comment; the package ships no licence file) | `polygon-clipping.js` |
| robust-predicates | 3.0.3 | Unlicense | `polygon-clipping.js` |
| mgrs | 1.0.0 | MIT | `proj4.js` |
| wkt-parser | 1.6.0 | MIT | `proj4.js` |
| but-unzip | 0.1.10 | Apache-2.0 | `fileformats.js` (also used directly for KMZ) |
| parsedbf | 2.0.0 | MIT | `fileformats.js` |
| proj4 (second copy, via shpjs) | 2.x | MIT | `fileformats.js` |

Known quirk: proj4 2.22.0 returns `NaN` for `+proj=laea` unless `+x_0=0 +y_0=0`
are written explicitly. `geometry.js` must always build the LAEA string with
them; a test in `tests/catalogue_tle.test.js` tracks the quirk.

To add or update a library: edit `PINS` in `scripts/vendor.sh` (and an entry file),
run `bash scripts/vendor.sh`, update this table, run `npm test`.

Copied as published (not rebuilt): MapLibre GL JS files from the npm package
`dist/` folder (`maplibre-gl.mjs`, `maplibre-gl-worker.mjs`, `maplibre-gl-shared.mjs`,
`maplibre-gl.css`).

## Fonts

`fonts/`: Barlow 400/600, Barlow Semi Condensed 400/600, Barlow Condensed 600,
WOFF2, Latin and Latin Extended subsets, from @fontsource/barlow,
@fontsource/barlow-semi-condensed and @fontsource/barlow-condensed 5.3.0.
Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`licenses/barlow-OFL.txt`).

## Basemap

`data/basemap/land.geojson` and `data/basemap/borders.geojson` come from
[Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/) 1:50m (`ne_50m_land`,
`ne_50m_admin_0_boundary_lines_land`), public domain; `land-110m.geojson` and
`borders-110m.geojson` (1:110m, about 150 KB together) load first and the 1:50m
files replace them when the user zooms in. They are generated by
`scripts/make_basemap.py` (properties removed, coordinates rounded to 0.01°).
It needs no tile server, so this default map works offline.

Online basemaps (terms checked 2026-11-10; the map falls back to the bundled
basemap when one cannot be loaded):

| Basemap | Source | Terms | Attribution shown |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel-2 cloudless 2024 | [EOxCloudless](https://cloudless.eox.at), WMTS layer `s2cloudless-2024_3857` (tiles.maps.eox.at, CORS enabled) | free for non-commercial use, including academic research, under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 ([licence summary](https://cloudless.eox.at/documentation/license)); commercial use needs a licence from EOX | "EOxCloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2024)" |
| OpenStreetMap light / dark / detailed | [OpenFreeMap](https://openfreemap.org) styles `positron`, `dark`, `liberty` (vector tiles, OpenMapTiles schema, OSM data under ODbL) | free, no key, no request limits on the public instance; attribution required | "OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles Data from OpenStreetMap" |

Esri World Imagery was not included: its terms for anonymous use from a public
web page could not be confirmed.

## Dark theme

The dark theme uses the [Dracula](https://draculatheme.com) colour palette
(MIT). Only colour values are used; no code is included.

Polygon and rectangle drawing is implemented in `js/roi.js` (about 100 lines)
instead of vendoring terra-draw, to keep one small, testable code path.
